content:
Let
\[
x=\frac{3y}{5y-1},\qquad y>\frac15.
\]
Then
\[
3x+4y=\frac{9y}{5y-1}+4y.
\]
Differentiate:
\[
f'(y)=4-\frac{9}{(5y-1)^2}.
\]
Set \(f'(y)=0\):
\[
(5y-1)^2=\frac94 \implies 5y-1=\frac32 \implies y=\frac12.
\]
Then
\[
x=\frac{3\cdot \frac12}{5\cdot \frac12-1}=1.
\]
Thus the minimum value is
\[
3x+4y=3(1)+4\left(\frac12\right)=5.
\]
\[
\boxed{5}
\]
